patterns.name: Async plus cancellation
patterns.rule: Public network methods use Async suffix and CancellationToken.

patterns.name: Domain model file
patterns.rule: Each package groups request/response models under Models.

patterns.name: Shared integration tests
patterns.rule: One xUnit project covers every package.

patterns.name: Offline route pinning
patterns.rule: A new or changed route gets a test that drives the real Posty5HttpClient against RecordingServer and asserts verb, path+query, body (and headers where relevant).

patterns.name: Guarded live facts
patterns.rule: Live tests use [ApiKeyFact] / [StoreFixtureFact] so a missing fixture reports skipped, never a silent pass.

patterns.name: Routes in a routes file (new clients)
patterns.rule: Clients added from 2026-10 keep their route constants in an internal *Routes.cs beside the client (AI_RULES section 4); older clients keep their private BasePath const.

patterns.name: createdFrom through ResolveCreatedFrom
patterns.rule: A create stamps createdFrom = request value ?? Posty5HttpClient.ResolveCreatedFrom(CreatedFromDefaults.X); never a literal.

patterns.name: String vocabularies as constants
patterns.rule: API vocabularies are string constants in a static class, not enums, so a new server value never breaks deserialization.
